full_judgment:
Md Abdur Rashid J: This appeal was presented by the plaintiff against judgment and decree dated 8-1-01 passed by Subordinate Judge, Court No.1 at Chittagong In Other Suit No. 88 of 2000, which rejected the plaint. 

 5. The learned Subordinate Judge by impugned decree rejected the plaint on the view that the suit was barred under sections 43/44 of the Ordinance. 

 7. On behalf of the respondent No. 8, Bangladesh, Mr Firujur Rahman, the learned Assistant Attorney-General, however, tried to defend the impugned decree by submitting that the plaintiff without making any application before the Deputy Commissioner under section 10(2) of the Ordinance instituted the suit and learned Subordinate Judge correctly found the suit barred and rejected the plaint.

 26. In the above view of the matter, the learned Joint District Judge clearly fell in serious error in law in rejecting the plaint, and the impugned decree is therefore liable to be set aside. 

 27. In the result, the appeal is allowed with cost. Impugned judgment and decree are hereby set aside. The Subordinate Judge is directed to proceed with the suit as usual in accordance with law but expeditiously.
